lines: Veera Venkata Satyanarayana Yannamani is a seller in the offer for sale, receiving money from 933,000 shares sold.
Proceeds of ₹30.79 crore are scheduled for On or about Tuesday, November 3, 2026, per the offer document's timetable, not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
The listing timetable was set 12 days ago, so this is a recent event; ask whether they plan to stay invested.
Unknown: their pre-offer holding and average cost of acquisition, so gain and retained value cannot be stated.
